_about: Visually verified fixes. ocr: OCR text -> the name printed on the card (checked on the scan; see review/labels.jpg). alias: printed name -> the same colour's name in our colors.json (checked in the book, see book.json). variant: name -> which of our two same-name colours the book uses.

_notes.Dark Grecnish Glaucous: misprint on card 51 (m09_r07); the name is Dark Greenish Glaucous
_notes.Vander Poel's Blue: the cards spell it Vander Poel's (No. 44, 48) and Vandar Poel's (No. 18, 68); Ridgway's name is Vanderpoel's Blue (after Emily Noyes Vanderpoel), which our data now uses; the book and Volume 1 print Vandar
_notes.Grayish Lavender: card 16 (m03_r09) has two different chips with this name, but the book gives A's CMYK (28 28 0 0) for No. 1, whose chip looks like B, and its colour index lists only A: use A everywhere; except card 16, which has both chips: there the scan decides (4th B, 6th A), as the book prints them (25 33 20 0, then 28 28 0 0)
_notes.Eugenia Red: the chips can't tell A from B; the book's colour index lists only A
_notes.Light Green: card 34 (m06_r09) prints Light Green; the book has Night Green, 52 0 100 0, as ours
_notes.Tawny Olive: card 32 (m06_r05) prints Tawny Olive; the book has Khaki there, and the chip matches Khaki on cards 9 and 12
_notes.Rosolanc Purple: card 45 (m08_r07) prints Rosolanc, as does Volume 1; Ridgway's name is Rosolane Purple, which our data now uses
